The '''Empire's Wrath's lightsaber''' was a [[Color/Legends|red]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] wielded by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] known as the [[Empire's Wrath]]. They acquired it from [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]'s [[Tomb of Naga Sadow|tomb]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] as part of their trials under [[Darth Baras]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Depending on the player's combat style, the lightsaber could be single-bladed, dual-bladed, or wielded alongside a second blade.
